FAQ

A few helpful answers

What does PC maintenance include?

Typical maintenance includes installing updates, checking startup and available storage, reviewing basic device health and optimising everyday performance. The exact checks depend on your computer and what it needs.

Do you clean laptop interiors?

PC interior cleaning is for desktop PCs. I carefully remove dust inside the desktop to help keep airflow clear.

Can you help remotely?

Yes, when the issue is suitable for remote support. We'll discuss the problem first, and I'll only arrange remote access with your permission. Never send passwords, one-time codes or banking details.

Where do you offer on-site support?

On-site visits are available by arrangement in Somerset West, Strand and Gordon's Bay.

How much does support cost?

Pricing is provided per quote based on the issue and work involved. I’ll discuss the cost with you before work begins.

How do I arrange support?

Use the support form, email mail@compusoft.co.za, call 082 059 3491 or WhatsApp me. Briefly describe the device and issue, and leave out passwords, one-time codes and banking details.
